heard: Deep Space is vibrating with an eerie hum. Voyager 1 heard it after crossing the border in 2012. But space is supposed to be a silent vacuum. The probe's main sensor had been dead since 1980. Scientists waited for a solar eruption to hit. The blast shook the plasma surrounding the ship. The blast revealed gas much thicker than anyone expected. This hum is the constant ghostly music of the galaxy itself. It proves the empty void is actually a thick soup of gas. Even in the dark, deep space is vibrating.
